title: DRBD: Add support for two-phase commit version 2 packets
description:
Since the commit\
56803fdcd4e7 drbd: propagate reachable_nodes mask with P_TWOPC_COMMIT\
in the drbd-headers repository, the structure of the two-phase commit
packets has changed. Handle this "version 2" format while maintaining
backwards compatibility.

notes.body:
Hi,

Can you attach a pcap on bug tracker ?

Sure. I'm not sure where exactly you would like them, so I've just uploaded them here.

Prior to the new feature:
[drbd-9.1.12-resize.pcapng](/uploads/33cd21559a60e2ec3571261dcaca2808/drbd-9.1.12-resize.pcapng)

With the new feature:
[drbd-9.1.13-resize.pcapng](/uploads/09886dc1481ad51afabd6a1844a9c970/drbd-9.1.13-resize.pcapng) See packet 78, which contains a `P_TWOPC_COMMIT` packet with `twopc_flags` and `reachable_nodes`.

can you check if there is not a typo ?

```
epan/dissectors/packet-drbd.c:1171 hf_drbd_history_uuid called consecutively at line 1171 - previous at 1170

```

@martin.r.mathieson

This is deliberate:

```c
    proto_tree_add_item(tree, hf_drbd_history_uuid, tvb, 16, 8, ENC_BIG_ENDIAN);
    proto_tree_add_item(tree, hf_drbd_history_uuid, tvb, 24, 8, ENC_BIG_ENDIAN);
```

`hf_drbd_history_uuid` is an array. In that case, which is for older versions of the protocol, there are 2 entries. In the newer version, `decode_payload_uuids110()`, there can be many entries.

This patch doesn't touch those lines anyway.

Do we need to do something to suppress the linter warning? Or is there a better way of declaring such arrays?
